calls.title: Review Financial Tracking
calls.summary: The team discussed the complexities of revenue data reconciliation between Orb and Stripe, noting fluctuations in Orb's recognized revenue and the need for custom reports in Stripe to prevent double counting. Manual adjustments and the impact of refunds and usage spikes were identified as potential sources of inaccuracies. The challenges in tracking churn and renewal data for Enterprise deals were addressed, highlighting undercounting issues and the necessity for correct data entries in HubSpot. They also identified operational risks related to failed payments and unmonitored free accounts, which may lead to unpaid usage. QuickBooks access was discussed for improved reconciliation of payment records and to align data across different systems, ultimately aiming to transition all billing to Orb for better clarity and consistency.
calls.keywords: Revenue Reconciliation, Orb, Stripe, HubSpot, QuickBooks, Usage-Based Billing
